1.label: very_easy
1.summary: 1 concurrent pump(s), 56px aperture, 32px smooth drift, 2200ms typical inhibitor separation, opposing flow False. Ordering is provisional, pending calibration. ATP stroke locks its selected height; 400ms extension, 1200ms open phase, 300ms recovery. Each deliberate pump control advances a fixed 100ms pulse; waiting does not.
1.natural_language: Transfer all solid solutes and exclude hollow magenta inhibitors. Move the selective pumps along the membrane and fire an ATP stroke for the incoming solutes. Each stroke spends one of four ATP, locks the selected height, extends for 0.4 seconds and opens briefly. Steering during a stroke queues the next height. The stroke cannot be cancelled. Each deliberate pump control advances one fixed 100ms pulse; waiting leaves particles and pumps unchanged. The pumps move during those pulses. One lost solute or admitted inhibitor ends the episode. Certification before completion also ends the episode. Inspect the chamber, then start perfusion. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. full.summary: Drag a pump to select its height. Keys 1–3 fire its committed ATP stroke. Flow continues during dragging and the stroke.

simplified.summary: Click a rail to select the identical height; FIRE buttons trigger the identical committed ATP stroke.
